claims.text: Hanja is classified as an extinct language in Korea, as it is not understood by modern Korean or Chinese speakers.
Hanja was the main writing system in Korea before the 20th century, but it has since become obsolete and is no longer in common use.
Hanja documents are difficult to understand without specialized knowledge, indicating that the language has effectively become extinct.
